component.name: MeshRepair
component.summary: Repair non-manifold and open meshes for 3D printing

description.p: MeshRepair finds and fixes the problems slicers complain about: open edges (holes and cracks), non-manifold edges and vertices, flipped normals and inside-out parts, duplicate and degenerate faces. It is an open replacement for the Windows-only "Fix model" function of Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer and PrusaSlicer, and can hand the repaired model straight to the slicer.
